I don't think whales are fast.
What do you think about sharks?
I think a seahorse is cute.
What sport do you want to try?
I want to try rock climbing.
What sport does your brother like?
Horse riding is more exciting than cycling.
Hang gliding is the most dangerous.

What's the most exciting sport for you?
What chores does your sister do?

Yesterday, I got up at eight o'clock.
I usually go to bed at nine thirty.

I usually do my homework at five thirty.

Falconry is a popular sport in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
Many people have falcons that are trained to hunt other birds and animals.
They can fly fast and dive even faster.
They see very far, so they can spot animals that are kilometers away.
They have very sharp talons that they use to attack and catch their prey.
It is as white as snow and as strong as a lion.
It is as scary as a tiger and as quiet as a fish.
It's beautiful and as fast as the wind.
It is very quiet and as slow as a snail.
It is smaller than a cat and as gray as an elephant.
This is the cheese that is in Jack's blank.
This is the blank that eats the cheese that is in Jack's house.
This is the blank that chases the mouse that eats the cheese that is in Jack's house.
This is the blank that scares the cat that chases the mouse...
This is the blank with the pointed horns that tosses the snake that scares the cat...
What is the good helper doing now?
She usually vacuums and cleans up her room,
Early in the morning or in the afternoon!
She's watching TV and eating a snack.
Her room is clean, her chores all done!
He usually feeds the fish and goes shopping,
He's playing games and sitting back.
The fish is full, his chores all done!
At six o'clock, I jump out of bed and brush my teeth.
At one o'clock, I finish school and ride the bus home.
At two o'clock, I eat my lunch and meet my friends.
At ten o'clock, I jump into bed and dream a lot!
Yesterday, my basketball team had a big game.
We met at the station to go to the tournament.
When I tried to catch a fly ball, I crashed into another player and fell on the ground.
I twisted my knee and injured my wrist.
After the game, I went to the hospital.
The doctor was very nice, so I will write him a thank-you note.
I want to be a doctor or a basketball player in the future.
I go to the market for...
one fish, for two fish, three eggs, for four eggs, five plums, for six plums, seven cookies, for eight cookies, nine pies, for ten pies, and bring them back home to eat.
I went to the market to buy food.
I'm eleven years old and I live in New York.
His cousins are coming to pick him up!
He has to unpack and look in the bag!
